question: Does the one P0586C universal signed compromise preserve and improve nonlinear multiple-image roots, or was its four-cluster source-plane gain another linear-screen artifact?

primary.selection_lineage: minimum all-four fixed-geometry RMS among 108 signed P0586C candidates; one of four candidates that improved all four source-plane scores

validation.roles: zero and four frozen negative strengths are each independently refit; the primary remains tau=-1.2 regardless of sensitivity results
validation.metric: equal-system nonlinear heldout image-position RMS with explicit training and heldout root completeness
validation.basin_control: twelve deterministic multistarts per system and model
validation.spent_disclosure: all systems and the primary are project-spent

claim_limits: This is an exact replay on project-spent clusters, not independent validation.
The cluster correction remains an angular closure on an inherited radial scalar lens parent.
The selected epsilon0=1 law is Newtonian in the spherical galaxy limit and does not explain SPARC rotation curves.
The projected baryon and missing stellar/ICL limitations are unchanged from P0586.
Sensitivity strengths diagnose topology but cannot replace the preselected tau=-1.2 primary.
